'''Derek Snook''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Seattle Grand Slam]] on 22 January 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor objective with Ominous Rumors]], according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d202">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-24-grand-slam-seattle-style-01-22-00d202/ grand-slam-seattle-style-01-22-00], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 24 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-24-grand-slam-seattle-style-01-22-00d202/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
